comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Valle del Bove

Further Research Quest name: Further Research on Mount Etna
Skill requirement: r8 Recognition, r10 Geography, ITA(Italian)
Pre-requisite discovery: Marble Statue of Hadrian discovery (from "Marble statue of the five wise emperors" quest) + Mount Etna discovery (from "Unfinished Map")
Required Sophia rank: 3
Sophia cost: 250 points
